registration.weighting: Equal seeds per cell. Every registered case is retained, including losses and negative paired differences. Existing A5 fixtures and gates stay unchanged; extra elite and V5 crews reported separately.
registration.rules: Actual production modules, automatic policy, no stat or reward overrides beyond the documented matched-power fixture.
registration.design: Design2 preflight correction only: absent Mark duration defaults0. Same TRAIN1–50 cases; original design2 cancelled before any sampled rows. No numeric tuning or changed sample.

definitions: Same original probe direct damage/detonate and heal/shield (including zero amount) action targets. Announced reactions counted only from events. Keyword frequency is battles with an application. Ultimates counted from executed action marker, so Daze replacements are not ultimates. No real-time or human claim.
